name: Scenario 1: Final Approach Congestion Offload (India)
description: Aircraft on ILS CAT II approach at 450 ft AGL. 5G cell at 900 m has critical 94% PRB congestion. Evaluates off-corridor traffic steering vs power boost.
key_learning: Demonstrates hard constraint rejection of power escalation (CON-INT-003, CON-IN-004) and recognition that DGCA AIC 19/2025 is NOT_YET_IN_FORCE.

candidate_actions.desc: Raise cell power +3 dB for QoS recovery
Steer traffic to neighbouring cell >1200 m from threshold

name: Scenario 2: Low-Altitude Flare Encroachment (Beam Shaping)
description: Aircraft on short touchdown flare at 50 ft AGL. Cell is located only 350 m from runway threshold at 35 m height. Requires physical antenna beam tilting to avoid altimeter saturation.
key_learning: Exercises physical MarginSimulator calculations (CLM-109), mechanically tilting antenna boresight downward to restore an otherwise deficient safety margin to +7.2 dB.

candidate_actions.desc: Raise cell power +3 dB to overcome urban building penetration
Apply 4° mechanical antenna downtilt + 20% PRB power cap
Retune carrier to 4150 MHz to avoid adjacent C-band interference

name: Scenario 3: Zero-Visibility CAT III / Legacy Aircraft (Escalate)
description: Dense fog zero-visibility autoland at US Hub Airport. Aircraft is a regional jet with an unverified legacy Group 4 radar altimeter under FAA AD 2023-12-12. High safety uncertainty.
key_learning: Demonstrates the precautionary principle (Rule 7) under severe safety risk and preserves documented conflict CONF-001 without averaging.

candidate_actions.desc: Emergency power boost +4 dB to maintain airport terminal connectivity
Freeze dynamic emission changes & escalate to human ATC / Network Coordinator
Shift carrier to 4120 MHz (adjacent to FSS guard band)
